_about: Daily word games people offer in their talk menu (scripts/util/daily_games.gd, v1.1.9). host = the NPC's npc_id; level = only in that map; requires_flag / unless_flag gate it on the story. Each game plays once per daily day and pays pay pesos on a win. minigame is a minigame line (DialogueUI.MINIGAME_SCRIPTS); pair_count -1 = the player's difficulty tier (GameState.get_minigame_word_count). word_pool word ids must be in data/word_bank.json.

market_match.label: Play Pedring's market match
market_match.intro: Quiet hour, gha. Match my goods with their English, and I'll pay you a little.
market_match.win: That's right! You know the market now.
market_match.lose: Close! Come back tomorrow and try again.

cafe_hangman.label: Guess the café word
cafe_hangman.intro: Slow afternoon. I'll think of a word, you guess it one letter at a time.
cafe_hangman.win: You got it! Next coffee's on the house... almost.
cafe_hangman.lose: Ah, not today. Same time tomorrow?

cafe_match.label: Match the café words
cafe_match.intro: Here's one my regulars like: match each word to what it means.
cafe_match.win: Fast hands! Like a real barista.

weave_sort.label: Help hang the weaves
weave_sort.intro: The new piña weaves came in. Hang each one on the display with its colour, and the right size rack.
weave_sort.win: Beautiful! The gallery looks ready for visitors.
weave_sort.lose: A few are on the wrong racks. We'll sort them again tomorrow.
